I can't find a blood glucose reading for October 2, 2026. Your local data has no blood glucose records at all.

- **What's stored locally:** Only 3 daily step-count records, covering October 1–3, 2026, from Google. Nothing else has been imported.
- **Blood glucose:** The Google blood glucose category has no local records, and the Fitbit side has no records either. A query for October 2 returned "no local records."

This could mean the data hasn't been imported yet, the permission wasn't granted, or your account simply has no glucose readings for that period. I can't tell which from the local database alone.

If you want me to check, I can run a connection status check on the Google account to see whether blood glucose access was granted. I can also start an import for the blood glucose category, which would pull it from the provider into the local database. Tell me which you'd like.
